node.statement: Applying conj-extcb to the datum and smallness established in node 1.2 yields one map v_+:M_{r+1}->A_R whose every amplification is a C_ext e-isomorphism, hence v_+ is an extended C_ext e-isomorphism by def-extended-delta-inclusion. Since e<=C_s2^0 t and D_2>=C_ext C_s2^0, weakening the defect bounds at every amplification shows that v_+ is an extended D_2 t-isomorphism.
